logic.zhCN: 初期震荡或回调测试64,650支撑。若守住，反弹结构保持完整，比特币可挑战66,956及67,300强压力，8月15日前可能尝试70,000，随后延续至9月基准长期目标85,000；9月为高点与转折风险窗口。

logic.en: Initial consolidation or pullback tests the 64,650 support. If it holds, Bitcoin can challenge 66,956 and 67,300, attempt 70,000 before August 15, then extend toward the 85,000 base long-range target in September — with September as a high and turning-risk window.
